# Vuko — Free AI Binaural Beats & Breathing Guide

> Vuko is the only browser-based binaural beats app that adapts to your breathing in real time. It is free and open-source, uses your microphone (optional) to monitor your breathing rhythm and automatically retune the beat frequency, and guides you into meditation, focus, relaxation, or deep sleep — all processed locally in your browser, no signup, no ads.

Vuko (https://www.vuko.life) is a browser-based AI guide that generates binaural beats via the Web Audio API to help users reach specific mental states — meditation, focus, relaxation, or deep sleep. It works by playing slightly different frequencies in each ear; the brain perceives the difference as a rhythmic "beat" that gently entrains brainwave activity toward a target state. Optionally, users can enable their microphone so Vuko can monitor breathing rhythm in real time and automatically adjust the beat frequency — all audio analysis happens entirely within the browser and is never uploaded to any server. The app is 100% free, requires no registration, displays no ads, and is available in 30 languages as a pure HTML/CSS/vanilla-JS site deployed on GitHub Pages.

## How it works

- Stereo headphones are required: each ear receives a slightly different frequency, and the brain perceives the difference as a "beat"
- Base carrier frequency is 200 Hz; the perceived beat frequency varies by target state
- Target beat frequencies: relaxed state ~6 Hz, focused state ~10 Hz, alert/tense state ~14 Hz
- Optional microphone input enables real-time breath monitoring; Vuko analyzes breathing rhythm and auto-adjusts the beat frequency accordingly
- All audio generation and microphone analysis run locally in the browser — no audio data is ever sent to a server

## Key facts

- Unique differentiator: breath-adaptive binaural beats — Vuko monitors your breathing via microphone in real time and auto-adjusts the beat frequency; no other browser-based binaural beats tool does this, and no wearable or extra hardware is required
- Free to use with no registration, no subscription, and no ads
- Open-source (MIT-licensed) on GitHub
- Privacy-first: all processing is local; no data leaves the browser
- Available in 30 languages, each at its own URL (`https://www.vuko.life/app/<lang>.html`)
- Built with pure HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript — no framework, no build step
- Deployed on GitHub Pages
